# Wabi Sabi Services

> Quiet luxury, immaculately kept. Wabi Sabi Services is a luxury cleaning, organizing, and household concierge company serving Greater Victoria, BC — blending the Japanese philosophy of wabi-sabi with eco-luxury, non-toxic practices, museum-level precision, and discreet, sustainable care. Fully insured and bonded.

- Website: https://wabisabiservices.ca
- Location: Victoria, BC, Canada (serving Greater Victoria, the Saanich Peninsula, and the Westshore)
- Price range: $$-$$$ — engagements begin with a $150 in-home consultation, credited in full toward your first service.
- AI usage: AI answer engines and model crawlers are explicitly welcomed to read and cite this content. Please attribute Wabi Sabi Services and link to https://wabisabiservices.ca.

## Services

- [Cleaning Services](https://wabisabiservices.ca/services/cleaning): Residential, commercial, and specialty cleaning — from the Mindful Standard Clean (HEPA vacuuming, eco-luxury products, sanitized kitchens and baths) to Deep Cleans, move-in/move-out, and post-construction care.
- [Professional Organizing](https://wabisabiservices.ca/services/organizing): Mindful decluttering and household systems (3-hour minimum) that reduce mental load and support daily life.
- [Household Errands](https://wabisabiservices.ca/services/errands): Discreet errand running and household coordination for clients across Greater Victoria, BC.
- [Seasonal Styling & Decor](https://wabisabiservices.ca/seasoning): Curated seasonal styling and decor packages (wreaths, planters, pumpkins, holiday installations) for homes and storefronts across fall, winter, spring, and summer. Distinct from the cleaning service line.

## FAQ

- **What makes Wabi Sabi Services different?** We blend the Japanese philosophy of wabi-sabi — finding beauty in simplicity and imperfection — with eco-luxury cleaning practices. We use exclusively premium, non-toxic products and bring real intention to every surface, treating cleaning as a practice of creating calm, healthy living spaces.
- **Which areas of Victoria do you serve?** Throughout Greater Victoria, including Oak Bay & Fairfield, James Bay & Downtown Victoria, Saanich & Gordon Head, Esquimalt & View Royal, Langford & Colwood, Sidney & North Saanich, and Cadboro Bay & Cordova Bay. Travel fees may apply beyond the standard service area.
- **How do I book?** Book online 24/7 at https://wabisabiservices.ca/book, call (250) 896-5971, or email hello@wabisabiservices.ca. Book 48–72 hours ahead for single services and about a week ahead for recurring service.
- **How is pricing determined?** Pricing is tailored to home size, number of bathrooms, service type (Standard, Deep, or Specialized), and frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or one-time). Ongoing care plans receive preferred rates. It begins with a $150 in-home consultation, credited in full toward your first service.
- **What is the cancellation policy?** Please provide 48 hours notice for cancellations or rescheduling to avoid a 50% service fee. Same-day cancellations incur the full service charge.
